entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It doesn't work right.

I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I can definitely look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's... I think it's broken. The heart rate is all over the place. I just think the whole thing is garbage, honestly. I don't have time for this.

I understand your frustration. A fluctuating heart rate reading is often something we can fix with a quick reset or a software update. Would you be open to trying a few troubleshooting steps with me? It should only take a moment.
No, no. I don't want to fix it. I just want my money back. I don't understand all this tech stuff, and I don't have time to be a technician. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
Okay, I understand. You'd prefer to process a return. Let me just pull up your account and review our policy. One moment, please.

Alright, thank you for waiting. I've got your order here. It looks like it was delivered 22 days ago. Let me just check our system... Okay, I see here that all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're at day 22, you are well within that window.
Oh! Really? That's great. I was so worried this was going to be a whole big thing.

Not at all. I can approve this return for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed.
Wow, thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
